'''LYNX Connector T2''' is a {{gear|5|Kit}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Rhodes Island and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.|The medics' preferred equipment. 
A connector component developed by Rhodes Island for data calibration. It can be connected to different health support systems to complete various forms of emergency medical care.}}
